in_marathi.name: Gajavadan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Elephant-faced, beloved by elephants
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gajavadan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Gajavadan is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘gaja’ meaning elephant and ‘vadana’ meaning face. This name signifies a person who is loved by elephants and has the face of an elephant. It is an honorable name given to those who possess strength, wisdom, and courage. In Hindu mythology, Lord Ganesha, the elephant-headed deity, is revered and beloved by all.
